mapper.select: SELECT id, name, intro, polygon_json, status, created_at, updated_at FROM university WHERE ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT id, name, intro, polygon_json, status, created_at, updated_at FROM university WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT fr.id AS resource_id, fr.public_url, ufr.sort_no FROM university_file_relation ufr JOIN file_resource fr ON fr.id = ufr.file_resource_id WHERE ufr.university_id = #{universityId} AND fr.status = 'ACTIVE' AND fr.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY ufr.sort_no ASC, ufr.file_resource_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO university (name, intro, polygon_json, status) VALUES (#{name}, #{intro}, #{polygonJson}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE university SET name = #{name}, intro = #{intro}, polygon_json = #{polygonJson} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE university SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE university SET deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO university_file_relation (university_id, file_resource_id, sort_no) VALUES (#{universityId}, #{resourceId}, #{sortNo})
